note: Iron County campground on the southeast shore of Weber Lake, a 61-acre no-wake lake for trout and panfish, next to the Whitecap Mountains ski area, with a boat launch, a swimming area, a playground and ATV/UTV trail access. --Claude
summary: Iron County page + rate sheet read: $32 electric (tax incl.), 12 sites (11 electric + 1 walk-in tent; Campspot 10 RV + 1 tent), showers/flush/water/dump, Campspot booking opening Jan 1. Note's '9 electric and 2 without' and unsourced 'tight and rustic' caveat removed. Lakeview kept (no site-level proof either way). Phone 715-562-0529 -> 715-561-2697.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The county's map is schematic (no scale) and draws sites 1, 2 and 5 nearest the lakeside path; imagery shows the sites as clearings in hardwood woods with a lawn and a fringe of shore trees between them and the water (~46.4088,-90.3940). No named site can be shown within ~50 m over open ground, so no upgrade; nothing argues for a downgrade either.

SEASON (not written - from a capture, not read today): Campspot's 2026-10-13 record had the park closed 2026-10-13 through 2027-05-01, i.e. 2027 opening about 05-02 (stored 05-07 is the 2026 date; closes 10-12 matches). Campspot showed no 2027 sites on 2026-11-16 (reservations open Jan 1).

SITE COUNT: county 12 (11 electrical + 1 tent); Campspot lists 10 RV (7 at 20/30 A, 3 at 20/30/50 A with water hookup) + 1 walk-in tent. The old note's '9 electric sites and 2 without' matched neither and is removed.
NOTE: the 'sites are reported tight and rustic, better for small rigs' caveat had no source I could find (Campspot lists every RV site at 45 ft max, gravel back-in); removed.

PHONE: stored 715-562-0529 -> 715-561-2697 (the county page's and Campspot's number; the rate sheet lists both). WEBSITE: both stored links live; Campspot's 'site' field ironcountyforest.org/weber-lake.html now redirects to the county Forestry & Parks page.
OHV: ATV/UTV trail access to Trail 6 - a general county campground with trail access, stays.
PIN 46.4084,-90.3948 sits on the shore strip by the swim area/dock; the camping loop is ~100-150 m east in the woods (~46.4090,-90.3935). Under 250 m, left.
